dish.title: Finnish Lohikeitto: Creamy Salmon Soup with Potatoes and Dill
dish.description: Yukon Gold potatoes, carrots, and leek simmered with allspice and bay leaves, enriched with heavy cream and butter, with chunks of salmon poached in at the end and a big handful of dill.

recipe_version.title: Finnish Lohikeitto: Creamy Salmon Soup with Potatoes and Dill
recipe_version.description: Yukon Gold potatoes, carrots, and leek simmered with allspice and bay leaves, enriched with heavy cream and butter, with chunks of salmon poached in at the end and a big handful of dill.

ingredients.name: leek
ingredients.preparation: white and pale green parts, halved, sliced, and washed

ingredients.name: salmon fillet
ingredients.preparation: cut into 1 1/2-inch chunks, pin bones removed

steps.title: Prep
steps.body: Halve, slice, and wash the leek. Peel and cube the potatoes, slice the carrots, cut the salmon into chunks (pulling any pin bones), and chop the dill.

steps.title: Soften the leek
steps.body: Melt the butter in the 5.5-quart Dutch oven over medium and cook the leek until soft, about 5 minutes.

steps.title: Simmer the vegetables
steps.body: Add the potatoes, carrots, and 5 cups water to the 5.5-quart Dutch oven with the allspice, bay leaves, and salt. Bring to a boil over high, about 9 minutes to come to a boil, then simmer until the potatoes are tender, about 12 minutes.

steps.title: Poach the salmon
steps.body: Stir in the cream and bring back to a bare simmer, about 2 minutes. Add the salmon and poach without stirring until just opaque and 145 F, about 5 minutes. Stir in most of the dill and the pepper.

steps.title: Serve
steps.body: Fish out the bay leaves and allspice berries. Ladle into bowls and scatter with the remaining dill.

coverage_contribution: Scandinavia has arctic char and Swedish meatballs; there is no Nordic soup and no salmon soup in the catalog. An easy cream-based fish soup.
near_duplicate_review: Compared with new-england-clam-chowder: salmon and dill in a thin cream broth with allspice, no clams, bacon, or flour roux. Compared with colombian-ajiaco: a cream-and-salmon soup, not chicken with three potatoes and guascas. Compared with miso-ginger-salmon: poached salmon chunks in soup, not a glazed fillet.
not_duplicate_of: Not a chowder (no roux, no bacon) and not bouillabaisse.
